============================================================================\n104\t\n105\t// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\n106\tbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n107\t    // Translate triangle to box center\n108\t    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n109\t    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n110\t    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n111\t\n112\t    // Triangle edges\n113\t    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n114\t    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n115\t    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n116\t\n117\t    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n118\t    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n119\t        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n120\t    };\n121\t\n122\t    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n123\t    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n124\t\n125\t    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n126\t    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n127\t\n128\t    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n129\t    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n130\t\n131\t    // Test triangle normal\n132\t    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n133\t    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n134\t    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n135\t              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n136\t              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n137\t    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n138\t\n139\t    // Test 9 edge cross products\n140\t    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n141\t        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n142\t        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n143\t        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n144\t        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n145\t                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n146\t                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n147\t        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n148\t        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n149\t    };\n150\t\n151\t    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n152\t    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n153\t    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n154\t        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n155\t            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n156\t            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n157\t                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n158\t            }\n159\t        }\n160\t    }\n161\t\n162\t    return true;\n163\t}\n164\t\n165\t// ============================================================================\n166\t// Octree for Spatial Acceleration\n167\t// ============================================================================\n168\t\n169\tconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\n170\tconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n171\t\n172\tclass Octree {\n173\tpublic:\n174\t    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n175\t    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n176\t    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n177\t    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n178\t    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n179\t\n180\t    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n181\t\n182\t    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n183\t        allTriangles = &triangles;\n184\t        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n185\t\n186\t        // Compute bounding box\n187\t        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n188\t        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n189\t        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n190\t            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n191\t                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n192\t                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n193\t                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n194\t                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n195\t                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n196\t                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n197\t            }\n198\t        }\n199\t\n200\t        // Collect all indices\n201\t        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n202\t        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n203\t\n204\t        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n205\t    }\n206\t\n207\tprivate:\n208\t    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n209\t        minBound = nodeMin;\n210\t        maxBound = nodeMax;\n211\t        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n212\t        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n213\t\n214\t        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n215\t        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n216\t            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n217\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n218\t            return;\n219\t        }\n220\t\n221\t        // Subdivide into 8 children\n222\t        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n223\t        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n224\t\n225\t        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n226\t            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n227\t\n228\t            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n229\t            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n230\t                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n231\t                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n232\t                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n233\t                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n234\t\n235\t                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n236\t                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n237\t                }\n238\t            }\n239\t        }\n240\t\n241\t        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n242\t        bool canSplit = false;\n243\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n244\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n245\t                canSplit = true;\n246\t                break;\n247\t            }\n248\t        }\n249\t\n250\t        if (!canSplit) {\n251\t            triangleIndices = indices;\n252\t            return;\n253\t        }\n254\t\n255\t        // Build children\n256\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n257\t            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n258\t                Vec3 childMin = center;\n259\t                Vec3 childMax = center;\n260\t                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n261\t                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n262\t                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n263\t                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n264\t                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n265\t                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n266\t\n267\t                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n268\t                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n269\t                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n270\t            }\n271\t        }\n272\t    }\n273\t\n274\tpublic:\n275\t    // Check if a ray intersects this node's bounding box\n276\t    bool rayIntersectsBox(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) const {\n277\t        Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n278\t        Vec3 c = p1 + d - center;\n279\t        Vec3 ad = {std::abs(d.x), std::abs(d.y), std::abs(d.z)};\n280\t\n281\t        if (std::abs(c.x) > halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n282\t        if (std::abs(c.y) > halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n283\t        if (std::abs(c.z) > halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n284\t\n285\t        if (std::abs(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > halfExtent.y * ad.z + halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n286\t        if (std::abs(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > halfExtent.z * ad.x + halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n287\t        if (std::abs(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > halfExtent.x * ad.y + halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n288\t\n289\t        return true;\n290\t    }\n291\t\n292\t    // Apply a function to all triangles potentially intersecting the ray\n293\t    // Returns true if the function returns true for any triangle\n294\t    template<typename Func>\n295\t    bool applyToTris(const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2, Func&& func) const {\n296\t        // If leaf node, check triangles directly\n297\t        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n298\t            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) {\n299\t                if (func(idx, (*allTriangles)[idx])) return true;\n300\t            }\n301\t            return false;\n302\t        }\n303\t\n304\t        // Otherwise, descend to children\n305\t        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n306\t            if (children[i] && children[i]->rayIntersectsBox(p1, p2)) ============================================================================\n317\t\n318\t// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\n319\tclass IcosphereMesh {\n320\tpublic:\n321\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n322\t\n323\t    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n324\t        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n325\t        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n326\t\n327\t        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n328\t            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n329\t            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n330\t            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n331\t            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n332\t            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n333\t            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n334\t            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n335\t            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n336\t            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n337\t            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n338\t            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n339\t            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n340\t        };\n341\t\n342\t        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n343\t        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n344\t            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n345\t            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n346\t            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n347\t            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n348\t        };\n349\t\n350\t        // Subdivide\n351\t        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n352\t            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n353\t            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n354\t\n355\t            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n356\t                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n357\t                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n358\t                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n359\t\n360\t                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n361\t                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n362\t                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n363\t                vertices.push_back(mid);\n364\t                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n365\t                return idx;\n366\t            };\n367\t\n368\t            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n369\t                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n370\t                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n371\t                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n372\t\n373\t newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n377\t            }\n378\t            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n379\t        }\n380\t\n381\t        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n382\t        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n383\t        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n384\t            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n385\t ============================================================================\n391\t// Random Number Generation\n392\t// ============================================================================\n393\t\n394\tclass RandomGenerator {\n395\t    std::mt19937 rng;\n396\t    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\n397\tpublic:\n398\t    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n399\t    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n400\t};\n401\t\n402\t// Generate a random point inside a triangle using barycentric coordinates\n403\tVec3 randomPointInTriangle(const Triangle& t, RandomGenerator& rng) {\n404\t    val_t u = rng.rand();\n405\t    val_t v = rng.rand();\n406\t    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n407\t        u = 1.0f - u;\n408\t        v = 1.0f - v;\n409\t    }\n410\t    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n411\t    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n412\t    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n413\t}\n414\t\n415\t// ============================================================================\n416\t// Ray-Triangle Intersection (Möller-Trumbore algorithm)\n417\t// ============================================================================\n418\t\n419\tval_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n420\t                            const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n421\t    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n422\t    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n423\t    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n424\t    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n425\t\n426\t    if (std::abs(det) < EPSILON) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n427\t\n428\t    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n429\t    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n430\t    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n431\t    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n432\t\n433\t    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n434\t    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n435\t    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n436\t\n437\t    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n438\t}\n439\t\n440\t// ============================================================================\n441\t// Visibility Testing (Octree-accelerated)\n442\t// ============================================================================\n443\t\n444\t// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle\n445\t// Uses octree for O(log N) instead of O(N) search\n446\tbool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n447\t                  const Octree& octree,\n448\t                  size_t srcTriIdx, size_t dstTriIdx) {\n449\t    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n450\t    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n451\t    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n452\t    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n453\t\n454\t    return octree.applyToTris(from, to, [&](size_t idx, const Triangle& tri) {\n455\t        if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) return false;\n456\t\n457\t        val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n458\t        if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n459\t            return true;  // Ray is blocked\n460\t        }\n461\t        return false;\n462\t    });\n463\t}\n464\t\n465\t// ============================================================================\n466\t// Form Factor Computation (Kij)\n467\t// ============================================================================\n468\t\n469\t// Compute the cosine of angle between vector and triangle normal\n470\tval_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n471\t    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n472\t    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n473\t    return std::max(ZERO, v.dot(normal) / vNorm);\n474\t}\n475\t\n476\t// Compute form factor Kij between triangle i (receiver) and triangle j (emitter)\n477\tval_t computeKij(size_t idxI, size_t idxJ,\n478\t                  const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles,\n479\t                  const Octree& octree,\n480\t                  RandomGenerator& rng) {\n481\t    const Triangle& triI = triangles[idxI];\n482\t    const Triangle& triJ = triangles[idxJ];\n483\t\n484\t    // Cull triangles facing the same direction\n485\t    if (triI.normal().dot(triJ.normal()) > 0.99f) return ZERO;\n486\t\n487\t    val_t kij = ZERO;\n488\t\n489\t    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n490\t        Vec3 pI = randomPointInTriangle(triI, rng);\n491\t        Vec3 pJ = randomPointInTriangle(triJ, rng);\n492\t\n493\t        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, octree, idxI, idxJ)) continue;\n494\t\n495\t        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n496\t        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n497\t        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n498\t\n499\t        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.normal());\n500\t        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.normal());\n501\t\n502\t        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n503\t\n504\t        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n505\t    }\n506\t\n507\t    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n508\t}\n509\t\n510\t// ============================================================================\n511\t// Tau (time delay) Computation\n512\t// ============================================================================\n513\t\n514\tint computeTau(const Triangle& triI, const Triangle& triJ) {\n515\t    val_t dist = (triI.center() - triJ.center()).norm();\n516\t    return static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t// ============================================================================\n520\t// Room Response Simulation State\n521\t// ============================================================================\n522\t\n523\tstruct SimulationState {\n524\t    size_t numTriangles;\n525\t    size_t numTimesteps;\n526\t\n527\t    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n528\t    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n529\t    std::vector<val_t> rho;         // Reflectivity (0.0 to 1.0)\n530\t    std::vector<val_t> kij;         // Form factors (N x N matrix, row-major)\n531\t    std::vector<int> tau;           // Time delays (N x N matrix, row-major)\n532\t    std::vector<val_t> radE;        // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n533\t    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n534\t    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source\n535\t\n536\t    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure\n537\t\n538\t    size_t sourceIndex;\n539\t\n540\t    size_t idx2d(size_t i, size_t j) const { return i * numTriangles + j; }\n541\t    size_t idxTN(size_t t, size_t n) const { return t * numTriangles + n; }\n542\t};\n543\t\n544\t// ============================================================================\n545\t// Initialization\n546\t// ============================================================================\n547\t\n548\tvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n549\t                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n550\t    // Generate mesh\n551\t    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n552\t    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n553\t    state.numTriangles = state.triangles.size();\n554\t    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n555\t    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % state.numTriangles;\n556\t\n557\t    printf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", state.numTriangles);\n558\t\n559\t    // Build octree for spatial acceleration\n560\t    printf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n561\t    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n562\t\n563\t    // Initialize areas\n564\t    state.areas.resize(state.numTriangles);\n565\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n566\t        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n567\t    }\n568\t\n569\t    // Initialize reflectivity\n570\t    state.rho.resize(state.numTriangles, reflectivity);\n571\t\n572\t    // Initialize matrices\n573\t    state.kij.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n574\t    state.tau.resize(state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles, 0);\n575\t    state.radE.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n576\t    state.radB.resize(timesteps * state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n577\t    state.distances.resize(state.numTriangles, ZERO);\n578\t\n579\t    // Set source emission (active for first half of timesteps)\n580\t    size_t timeOn = 0;\n581\t    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n582\t    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n583\t        state.radE[state.idxTN(t, state.sourceIndex)] = 1.0f;\n584\t    }\n585\t}\n586\t\n587\t// ============================================================================\n588\t// Precomputation Phase\n589\t// ============================================================================\n590\t\n591\tvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n592\t    printf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n593\t    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n594\t\n595\t    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n596\t        for (size_t j = 0; j < state.numTriangles; ++j) {\n597\t edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = Contiguous row block [begin, end) of an N-row problem owned by a rank\nstruct RowRange {\n    size_t begin, end;\n};\n\nRowRange rowRangeOf(int rank, size_t N) {\n    return {N * static_cast<size_t>(rank) / gSize, N * static_cast<size_t>(rank + 1) / gSize};\n}\n\n// Gathers every rank's row block of a length-N array in place across all ranks\ntemplate <typename T>\nvoid allgatherRowBlocks(T* data, size_t N, MPI_Datatype type) {\n    std::vector<int> counts(gSize);\n    std::vector<int> displs(gSize);\n    for (int r = 0; r < gSize; ++r) {\n        RowRange rr = rowRangeOf(r, N);\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.end - rr.begin);\n        displs[r] = static_cast<int>(rr.begin);\n    }\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, data, counts.data(), displs.data(), type,\n                   MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\n// Binds this rank to a GPU, round-robin over the ranks that share the node\nvoid selectDevice() {\n    MPI_Comm localComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, gRank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &localComm);\n    int localRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(localComm, &localRank);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&localComm);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(localRank % deviceCount));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Triangle-Box Overlap Test (for octree construction)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Separating axis test for triangle-box overlap\nbool triangleBoxOverlap(const Vec3& boxCenter, const Vec3& boxHalfSize, const Triangle& tri) {\n    // Translate triangle to box center\n    Vec3 v0 = tri.a - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v1 = tri.b - boxCenter;\n    Vec3 v2 = tri.c - boxCenter;\n\n    // Triangle edges\n    Vec3 e0 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e1 = v2 - v1;\n    Vec3 e2 = v0 - v2;\n\n    // Test box normals (AABB axes)\n    auto minMax3 = [](val_t a, val_t b, val_t c) {\n        return std::make_pair(std::min({a, b, c}), std::max({a, b, c}));\n    };\n\n    auto [minX, maxX] = minMax3(v0.x, v1.x, v2.x);\n    if (minX > boxHalfSize.x || maxX < -boxHalfSize.x) return false;\n\n    auto [minY, maxY] = minMax3(v0.y, v1.y, v2.y);\n    if (minY > boxHalfSize.y || maxY < -boxHalfSize.y) return false;\n\n    auto [minZ, maxZ] = minMax3(v0.z, v1.z, v2.z);\n    if (minZ > boxHalfSize.z || maxZ < -boxHalfSize.z) return false;\n\n    // Test triangle normal\n    Vec3 triNormal = e0.cross(e1);\n    val_t d = triNormal.dot(v0);\n    val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(triNormal.x) +\n              boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(triNormal.y) +\n              boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(triNormal.z);\n    if (std::abs(d) > r) return false;\n\n    // Test 9 edge cross products\n    auto testAxis = [&](const Vec3& axis) {\n        val_t p0 = axis.dot(v0);\n        val_t p1 = axis.dot(v1);\n        val_t p2 = axis.dot(v2);\n        val_t r = boxHalfSize.x * std::abs(axis.x) +\n                  boxHalfSize.y * std::abs(axis.y) +\n                  boxHalfSize.z * std::abs(axis.z);\n        auto [minP, maxP] = minMax3(p0, p1, p2);\n        return !(minP > r || maxP < -r);\n    };\n\n    Vec3 axes[3] = {{1,0,0}, {0,1,0}, {0,0,1}};\n    Vec3 edges[3] = {e0, e1, e2};\n    for (const auto& axis : axes) {\n        for (const auto& edge : edges) {\n            Vec3 crossAxis = axis.cross(edge);\n            if (crossAxis.squaredNorm() > EPSILON) {\n                if (!testAxis(crossAxis)) return false;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Octree for Spatial Acceleration\n// ============================================================================\n\nconstexpr size_t MAX_OCTREE_TRIS = 8;\nconstexpr val_t MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE = 0.5f;\n\nclass Octree {\npublic:\n    Vec3 minBound, maxBound;\n    Vec3 halfExtent, center;\n    std::unique_ptr<Octree> children[8];\n    std::vector<size_t> triangleIndices;  // Indices into the global triangle list\n    const std::vector<Triangle>* allTriangles;  // Pointer to all triangles\n\n    Octree() : allTriangles(nullptr) {}\n\n    void build(const std::vector<Triangle>& triangles) {\n        allTriangles = &triangles;\n        if (triangles.empty()) return;\n\n        // Compute bounding box\n        minBound = triangles[0].a;\n        maxBound = triangles[0].a;\n        for (const auto& tri : triangles) {\n            for (const auto* v : {&tri.a, &tri.b, &tri.c}) {\n                minBound.x = std::min(minBound.x, v->x);\n                minBound.y = std::min(minBound.y, v->y);\n                minBound.z = std::min(minBound.z, v->z);\n                maxBound.x = std::max(maxBound.x, v->x);\n                maxBound.y = std::max(maxBound.y, v->y);\n                maxBound.z = std::max(maxBound.z, v->z);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Collect all indices\n        std::vector<size_t> allIndices(triangles.size());\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < triangles.size(); ++i) allIndices[i] = i;\n\n        buildNode(allIndices, minBound, maxBound);\n    }\n\n    // Flatten into index-based nodes for device traversal. Node 0 is the root.\n    uint32_t flatten(std::vector<DevNode>& nodes, std::vector<uint32_t>& triIdx) const {\n        const uint32_t self = static_cast<uint32_t>(nodes.size());\n        nodes.emplace_back();\n\n        DevNode nd{};\n        nd.center = center;\n        nd.halfExtent = halfExtent;\n        std::fill(std::begin(nd.child), std::end(nd.child), -1);\n        if (!triangleIndices.empty()) {\n            nd.triBegin = static_cast<uint32_t>(triIdx.size());\n            nd.triCount = static_cast<uint32_t>(triangleIndices.size());\n            for (size_t idx : triangleIndices) triIdx.push_back(static_cast<uint32_t>(idx));\n        } else {\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                if (children[i]) nd.child[i] = static_cast<int32_t>(children[i]->flatten(nodes, triIdx));\n            }\n        }\n        nodes[self] = nd;\n        return self;\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    void buildNode(const std::vector<size_t>& indices, const Vec3& nodeMin, const Vec3& nodeMax) {\n        minBound = nodeMin;\n        maxBound = nodeMax;\n        halfExtent = (maxBound - minBound) * 0.5f;\n        center = (minBound + maxBound) * 0.5f;\n\n        // If few enough triangles or too small, make this a leaf\n        if (indices.size() <= MAX_OCTREE_TRIS ||\n            (maxBound - minBound).norm() < MAX_OCTREE_LEAF_SIZE) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Subdivide into 8 children\n        Vec3 childHalfSize = halfExtent * 0.5f;\n        std::vector<size_t> childIndices[8];\n\n        for (size_t idx : indices) {\n            const Triangle& tri = (*allTriangles)[idx];\n\n            // Check which children this triangle overlaps\n            for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n                Vec3 childCenter = center;\n                childCenter.x += (i & 1) ? childHalfSize.x : -childHalfSize.x;\n                childCenter.y += (i & 2) ? childHalfSize.y : -childHalfSize.y;\n                childCenter.z += (i & 4) ? childHalfSize.z : -childHalfSize.z;\n\n                if (triangleBoxOverlap(childCenter, childHalfSize, tri)) {\n                    childIndices[i].push_back(idx);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check if we can't split further (all triangles in one child)\n        bool canSplit = false;\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty() && childIndices[i].size() < indices.size()) {\n                canSplit = true;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n\n        if (!canSplit) {\n            triangleIndices = indices;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        // Build children\n        for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i) {\n            if (!childIndices[i].empty()) {\n                Vec3 childMin = center;\n                Vec3 childMax = center;\n                childMin.x = (i & 1) ? center.x : minBound.x;\n                childMax.x = (i & 1) ? maxBound.x : center.x;\n                childMin.y = (i & 2) ? center.y : minBound.y;\n                childMax.y = (i & 2) ? maxBound.y : center.y;\n                childMin.z = (i & 4) ? center.z : minBound.z;\n                childMax.z = (i & 4) ? maxBound.z : center.z;\n\n                children[i] = std::make_unique<Octree>();\n                children[i]->allTriangles = allTriangles;\n                children[i]->buildNode(childIndices[i], childMin, childMax);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Mesh Generation: Icosphere\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Generate an icosphere by subdividing an icosahedron\nclass IcosphereMesh {\npublic:\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n\n    IcosphereMesh(int subdivisions, val_t radius) {\n        // Initial icosahedron vertices\n        const val_t t = (1.0f + std::sqrt(5.0f)) / 2.0f;\n\n        std::vector<Vec3> vertices = {\n            Vec3(-1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1,  t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 1, -t,  0).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1,  t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0, -1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( 0,  1, -t).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3( t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0, -1).normalized() * radius,\n            Vec3(-t,  0,  1).normalized() * radius\n        };\n\n        // Initial icosahedron faces (20 triangles)\n        std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> faces = {\n            {0, 11, 5}, {0, 5, 1}, {0, 1, 7}, {0, 7, 10}, {0, 10, 11},\n            {1, 5, 9}, {5, 11, 4}, {11, 10, 2}, {10, 7, 6}, {7, 1, 8},\n            {3, 9, 4}, {3, 4, 2}, {3, 2, 6}, {3, 6, 8}, {3, 8, 9},\n            {4, 9, 5}, {2, 4, 11}, {6, 2, 10}, {8, 6, 7}, {9, 8, 1}\n        };\n\n        // Subdivide\n        for (int i = 0; i < subdivisions; ++i) {\n            std::vector<std::array<idx_t, 3>> newFaces;\n            std::map<std::pair<idx_t, idx_t>, idx_t> midpointCache;\n\n            auto getMidpoint = [&](idx_t i1, idx_t i2) -> idx_t {\n                auto key = std::make_pair(std::min(i1, i2), std::max(i1, i2));\n                auto it = midpointCache.find(key);\n                if (it != midpointCache.end()) return it->second;\n\n                Vec3 mid = (vertices[i1] + vertices[i2]) / 2.0f;\n                mid = mid.normalized() * radius;\n                idx_t idx = static_cast<idx_t>(vertices.size());\n                vertices.push_back(mid);\n                midpointCache[key] = idx;\n                return idx;\n            };\n\n            for (const auto& face : faces) {\n                idx_t a = getMidpoint(face[0], face[1]);\n                idx_t b = getMidpoint(face[1], face[2]);\n                idx_t c = getMidpoint(face[2], face[0]);\n\n                newFaces.push_back({face[0], a, c});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[1], b, a});\n                newFaces.push_back({face[2], c, b});\n                newFaces.push_back({a, b, c});\n            }\n            faces = std::move(newFaces);\n        }\n\n        // Build triangles (normals pointing inward for a \"room\")\n        triangles.reserve(faces.size());\n        for (const auto& face : faces) {\n            // Reverse winding to make normals point inward\n            triangles.emplace_back(vertices[face[2]], vertices[face[1]], vertices[face[0]]);\n        }\n    }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Random Number Generation\n// ============================================================================\n\nclass RandomGenerator {\n    std::mt19937 rng;\n    std::uniform_real_distribution<val_t> dist;\npublic:\n    explicit RandomGenerator(uint32_t seed = 42) : rng(seed), dist(0.0f, 1.0f) {}\n    val_t rand() { return dist(rng); }\n    // Advance the stream by n engine outputs (each rand() consumes exactly one)\n    void skip(unsigned long long n) { rng.discard(n); }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Device Geometry: Visibility and Form Factors\n// ============================================================================\n\n// Point in triangle from two uniforms, identical to the sequential randomPointInTriangle\nHD inline Vec3 samplePointInTriangle(const DevTri& t, val_t u, val_t v) {\n    if (u + v > 1.0f) {\n        u = 1.0f - u;\n        v = 1.0f - v;\n    }\n    Vec3 ab = t.b - t.a;\n    Vec3 ac = t.c - t.a;\n    return t.a + ab * u + ac * v;\n}\n\n// Möller-Trumbore ray-triangle intersection\n__device__ inline val_t rayTriangleIntersect(const Vec3& orig, const Vec3& dir,\n                                             const Vec3& v0, const Vec3& v1, const Vec3& v2) {\n    Vec3 e1 = v1 - v0;\n    Vec3 e2 = v2 - v0;\n    Vec3 pvec = dir.cross(e2);\n    val_t det = e1.dot(pvec);\n\n    if (fabsf(det) < EPSILON) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    val_t invDet = 1.0f / det;\n    Vec3 tvec = orig - v0;\n    val_t u = tvec.dot(pvec) * invDet;\n    if (u < 0.0f || u > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    Vec3 qvec = tvec.cross(e1);\n    val_t v = dir.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n    if (v < 0.0f || u + v > 1.0f) return FLT_MAX;\n\n    return e2.dot(qvec) * invDet;\n}\n\n// Slab-style test of the segment p1-p2 against a node's bounding box\n__device__ inline bool segmentHitsNode(const DevNode& nd, const Vec3& p1, const Vec3& p2) {\n    Vec3 d = (p2 - p1) * 0.5f;\n    Vec3 c = p1 + d - nd.center;\n    Vec3 ad = {fabsf(d.x), fabsf(d.y), fabsf(d.z)};\n\n    if (fabsf(c.x) > nd.halfExtent.x + ad.x) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.y) > nd.halfExtent.y + ad.y) return false;\n    if (fabsf(c.z) > nd.halfExtent.z + ad.z) return false;\n\n    if (fabsf(d.y * c.z - d.z * c.y) > nd.halfExtent.y * ad.z + nd.halfExtent.z * ad.y + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.z * c.x - d.x * c.z) > nd.halfExtent.z * ad.x + nd.halfExtent.x * ad.z + EPSILON) return false;\n    if (fabsf(d.x * c.y - d.y * c.x) > nd.halfExtent.x * ad.y + nd.halfExtent.y * ad.x + EPSILON) return false;\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Check if a ray between two triangles is blocked by any other triangle (octree-accelerated)\n__device__ bool isRayBlocked(const Vec3& from, const Vec3& to,\n                             const DevNode* nodes, const uint32_t* triIdx, const DevTri* tris,\n                             uint32_t srcTriIdx, uint32_t dstTriIdx) {\n    Vec3 dir = to - from;\n    val_t rayLen = dir.norm();\n    if (rayLen < EPSILON) return true;\n    Vec3 dirNorm = dir / rayLen;\n\n    // The root is always visited. Children are only pushed after their box test.\n    uint32_t stack[NODE_STACK_SIZE];\n    int sp = 0;\n    stack[sp++] = 0;\n\n    while (sp > 0) {\n        const DevNode& nd = nodes[stack[--sp]];\n        if (nd.triCount > 0) {\n            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < nd.triCount; ++k) {\n                uint32_t idx = triIdx[nd.triBegin + k];\n                if (idx == srcTriIdx || idx == dstTriIdx) continue;\n\n                const DevTri& tri = tris[idx];\n                val_t dist = rayTriangleIntersect(from, dirNorm, tri.a, tri.b, tri.c);\n                if (dist > EPSILON && dist < rayLen - EPSILON) {\n                    return true;  // Ray is blocked\n                }\n            }\n        } else {\n            for (int c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n                int32_t ch = nd.child[c];\n                if (ch >= 0 && segmentHitsNode(nodes[ch], from, to)) {\n                    stack[sp++] = static_cast<uint32_t>(ch);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return false;\n}\n\n// Cosine of angle between vector and surface normal, clamped at zero\n__device__ inline val_t cosPhi(const Vec3& v, const Vec3& normal) {\n    val_t vNorm = v.norm();\n    if (vNorm <= EPSILON) return ZERO;\n    val_t d = v.dot(normal) / vNorm;\n    return (ZERO < d) ? d : ZERO;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation State\n// ============================================================================\n\nstruct SimulationState {\n    size_t numTriangles;\n    size_t numTimesteps;\n    size_t sourceIndex;\n    val_t reflectivity;\n\n    // Receiver rows [rowBegin, rowEnd) of the Kij/Tau matrices owned by this rank\n    size_t rowBegin;\n    size_t rowEnd;\n\n    std::vector<Triangle> triangles;\n    std::vector<val_t> areas;       // Area of each triangle\n    std::vector<val_t> radB;        // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix), replicated on all ranks\n    std::vector<val_t> distances;   // Computed distances from source, replicated on all ranks\n\n    Octree octree;                  // Spatial acceleration structure (host build)\n\n    // Device-resident data. Local matrices use layout [j * nLoc + il] for receiver row il\n    DevBuf<DevTri> trisD;\n    DevBuf<val_t> areasD;\n    DevBuf<DevNode> nodesD;\n    DevBuf<uint32_t> triIdxD;\n    DevBuf<int> tauD;               // Time delays (local rows)\n    DevBuf<val_t> kijD;             // Form factors (local rows)\n    DevBuf<val_t> radBD;            // Reflected radiosity (T x N matrix)\n    DevBuf<val_t> radED;            // Emission radiosity (T x N matrix)\n\n    size_t localRows() const { return rowEnd - rowBegin; }\n};\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Initialization\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid initializeSimulation(SimulationState& state, int subdivisions, size_t timesteps,\n                          size_t sourceIdx, val_t reflectivity) {\n    // Generate mesh\n    IcosphereMesh mesh(subdivisions, 10.0f);  // Radius 10 units\n    state.triangles = std::move(mesh.triangles);\n    const size_t N = state.triangles.size();\n    state.numTriangles = N;\n    state.numTimesteps = timesteps;\n    state.sourceIndex = sourceIdx % N;\n    state.reflectivity = reflectivity;\n\n    RowRange rows = rowRangeOf(gRank, N);\n    state.rowBegin = rows.begin;\n    state.rowEnd = rows.end;\n    const size_t nLoc = state.localRows();\n\n    rootPrintf(\"Generated icosphere mesh with %zu triangles\\n\", N);\n\n    // Build octree for spatial acceleration and flatten it for the device\n    rootPrintf(\"Building octree...\\n\");\n    state.octree.build(state.triangles);\n    std::vector<DevNode> nodes;\n    std::vector<uint32_t> triIdx;\n    state.octree.flatten(nodes, triIdx);\n\n    std::vector<DevTri> devTris(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        const Triangle& t = state.triangles[i];\n        devTris[i] = {t.a, t.b, t.c, t._normal};\n    }\n\n    // Initialize areas\n    state.areas.resize(N);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < N; ++i) {\n        state.areas[i] = state.triangles[i].area();\n    }\n\n    // Emission: source is active for first half of timesteps\n    std::vector<val_t> radE(timesteps * N, ZERO);\n    size_t timeOn = 0;\n    size_t timeOff = timesteps / 2;\n    for (size_t t = timeOn; t < timeOff; ++t) {\n        radE[t * N + state.sourceIndex] = 1.0f;\n    }\n\n    state.radB.assign(timesteps * N, ZERO);\n    state.distances.assign(N, ZERO);\n\n    state.trisD = uploadDevice(devTris);\n    state.areasD = uploadDevice(state.areas);\n    state.nodesD = uploadDevice(nodes);\n    state.triIdxD = uploadDevice(triIdx);\n    state.radED = uploadDevice(radE);\n    state.radBD = uploadDevice(state.radB);\n    state.tauD = allocDevice<int>(nLoc * N);\n    state.kijD = allocDevice<val_t>(nLoc * N);\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Precomputation Phase\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeTimeDelays(SimulationState& state) {\n    rootPrintf(\"Computing time delays (Tau)...\\n\");\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t nLoc = state.localRows();\n\n    std::vector<int> tau(nLoc * N, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        for (size_t il = 0; il < nLoc; ++il) {\n            size_t i = state.rowBegin + il;\n            if (i == j) continue;\n            float dist = (state.triangles[i].center() - state.triangles[j].center()).norm();\n            tau[j * nLoc + il] = static_cast<int>(std::ceil(dist * INV_WAVE_SPEED));\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (!tau.empty()) {\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.tauD.get(), tau.data(), tau.size() * sizeof(int), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    }\n}\n\n// True if the pair (receiver i, emitter j) is evaluated, i.e. not culled and not the same triangle.\n// Only evaluated pairs consume Monte Carlo samples.\nbool consumesSamples(const std::vector<Triangle>& tris, size_t i, size_t j) {\n    return i != j && !(tris[i].normal().dot(tris[j].normal()) > 0.99f);\n}\n\n// Draws the samples for each evaluated pair of a row batch, in the sequential program's order\n// (row-major, culled pairs consume nothing). Slots map each pair to its sample block, or -1.\nsize_t drawBatchSamples(RandomGenerator& rng, const std::vector<Triangle>& tris, size_t firstRow,\n                        size_t rows, int* slots, val_t* samples) {\n    const size_t N = tris.size();\n    size_t drawn = 0;\n    for (size_t bl = 0; bl < rows; ++bl) {\n        const size_t i = firstRow + bl;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            int& slot = slots[bl * N + j];\n            if (!consumesSamples(tris, i, j)) {\n                slot = -1;\n                continue;\n            }\n            slot = static_cast<int>(drawn);\n            val_t* block = samples + drawn * SAMPLES_PER_PAIR;\n            for (int k = 0; k < SAMPLES_PER_PAIR; ++k) block[k] = rng.rand();\n            ++drawn;\n        }\n    }\n    return drawn;\n}\n\n// Form factor for one evaluated pair: the device version of the sequential computeKij\n__device__ val_t computeKijDevice(const DevTri* tris, const DevNode* nodes, const uint32_t* triIdx,\n                                  uint32_t i, uint32_t j, const val_t* smp) {\n    const DevTri& triI = tris[i];\n    const DevTri& triJ = tris[j];\n\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n    for (int r = 0; r < NUM_RAYS; ++r) {\n        const val_t* q = smp + 4 * r;\n        Vec3 pI = samplePointInTriangle(triI, q[0], q[1]);\n        Vec3 pJ = samplePointInTriangle(triJ, q[2], q[3]);\n\n        if (isRayBlocked(pI, pJ, nodes, triIdx, tris, i, j)) continue;\n\n        Vec3 v = pJ - pI;\n        val_t distSqr = v.squaredNorm();\n        if (distSqr < EPSILON) continue;\n\n        val_t cosPhiI = cosPhi(v, triI.n);\n        val_t cosPhiJ = cosPhi(-v, triJ.n);\n\n        if (cosPhiI <= ZERO || cosPhiJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        kij += (cosPhiI * cosPhiJ) / (PI * distSqr);\n    }\n\n    return kij * INV_NUM_RAYS;\n}\n\n// One thread per (batch row, emitter) pair. Writes into the local transposed Kij matrix.\n__global__ void formFactorKernel(const DevTri* tris, const DevNode* nodes, const uint32_t* triIdx,\n                                 const int* slots, const val_t* samples,\n                                 size_t N, size_t firstRow, size_t firstLocal, size_t batchRows,\n                                 size_t nLoc, val_t* kijT) {\n    const size_t g = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (g >= batchRows * N) return;\n\n    const size_t bl = g / N;\n    const size_t j = g % N;\n    const size_t i = firstRow + bl;\n    const size_t il = firstLocal + bl;\n\n    const int slot = slots[g];\n    val_t kij = ZERO;\n    if (slot >= 0) {\n        kij = computeKijDevice(tris, nodes, triIdx, static_cast<uint32_t>(i), static_cast<uint32_t>(j),\n                               samples + static_cast<size_t>(slot) * SAMPLES_PER_PAIR);\n    }\n    kijT[j * nLoc + il] = kij;\n}\n\n// Computes the form factors of the local rows, streaming the RNG samples in batches.\n// Sample generation for batch b+1 overlaps the GPU work of batch b.\nvoid computeFormFactors(SimulationState& state) {\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t nLoc = state.localRows();\n    rootPrintf(\"Computing form factors (Kij)...\\n\");\n\n    // Every rank must start the shared sample stream at the position its first row reaches.\n    // Culled pairs consume no samples, so the count per row is needed for all rows before it.\n    std::vector<unsigned long long> samplesPerRow(N, 0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 16)\n    for (size_t il = 0; il < nLoc; ++il) {\n        const size_t i = state.rowBegin + il;\n        unsigned long long count = 0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n            if (consumesSamples(state.triangles, i, j)) ++count;\n        }\n        samplesPerRow[i] = count;\n    }\n    allgatherRowBlocks(samplesPerRow.data(), N, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG);\n\n    unsigned long long samplesBefore = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.rowBegin; ++i) samplesBefore += samplesPerRow[i];\n\n    RandomGenerator rng(42);\n    rng.skip(samplesBefore * SAMPLES_PER_PAIR);\n\n    // Batch geometry: bounded host and device staging memory\n    const size_t bytesPerRow = N * (SAMPLES_PER_PAIR * sizeof(val_t) + sizeof(int));\n    const size_t rowsPerBatch = std::max<size_t>(1, std::min(nLoc, TARGET_BATCH_BYTES / bytesPerRow));\n    const size_t numBatches = (nLoc + rowsPerBatch - 1) / rowsPerBatch;\n    const size_t batchCap = rowsPerBatch * N;\n\n    PinnedBuf<int> slotsH[2] = {allocPinned<int>(batchCap), allocPinned<int>(batchCap)};\n    PinnedBuf<val_t> samplesH[2] = {allocPinned<val_t>(batchCap * SAMPLES_PER_PAIR),\n                                    allocPinned<val_t>(batchCap * SAMPLES_PER_PAIR)};\n    DevBuf<int> slotsD = allocDevice<int>(batchCap);\n    DevBuf<val_t> samplesD = allocDevice<val_t>(batchCap * SAMPLES_PER_PAIR);\n\n    cudaStream_t stream;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamCreate(&stream));\n\n    size_t drawnCur = 0;\n    if (numBatches > 0) {\n        const size_t rows = std::min(rowsPerBatch, nLoc);\n        drawnCur = drawBatchSamples(rng, state.triangles, state.rowBegin, rows, slotsH[0].get(), samplesH[0].get());\n    }\n\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < numBatches; ++b) {\n        const size_t cur = b & 1;\n        const size_t nxt = cur ^ 1;\n        const size_t firstLocal = b * rowsPerBatch;\n        const size_t rows = std::min(rowsPerBatch, nLoc - firstLocal);\n        const size_t firstRow = state.rowBegin + firstLocal;\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(slotsD.get(), slotsH[cur].get(), rows * N * sizeof(int),\n                                   cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n        if (drawnCur > 0) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(samplesD.get(), samplesH[cur].get(),\n                                       drawnCur * SAMPLES_PER_PAIR * sizeof(val_t),\n                                       cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, stream));\n        }\n\n        const size_t work = rows * N;\n        const int blocks = static_cast<int>((work + THREADS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / THREADS_PER_BLOCK);\n        formFactorKernel<<<blocks, THREADS_PER_BLOCK, 0, stream>>>(\n            state.trisD.get(), state.nodesD.get(), state.triIdxD.get(),\n            slotsD.get(), samplesD.get(), N, firstRow, firstLocal, rows, nLoc, state.kijD.get());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n\n        // Host-side sampling for the next batch overlaps the kernel\n        size_t drawnNxt = 0;\n        if (b + 1 < numBatches) {\n            const size_t nextRows = std::min(rowsPerBatch, nLoc - (b + 1) * rowsPerBatch);\n            drawnNxt = drawBatchSamples(rng, state.triangles, state.rowBegin + (b + 1) * rowsPerBatch,\n                                        nextRows, slotsH[nxt].get(), samplesH[nxt].get());\n        }\n\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(stream));\n        drawnCur = drawnNxt;\n\n        rootPrintf(\"  Progress: %zu/%zu triangles\\n\", firstLocal + rows, nLoc);\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamDestroy(stream));\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Simulation Phase (Wave Propagation)\n// ============================================================================\n\n// One timestep of radiosity for the local receiver rows. Thread per receiver row.\n__global__ void simulationStepKernel(int t, size_t N, size_t nLoc, size_t rowBegin, val_t rho,\n                                     const val_t* areas, const int* tau, const val_t* kijT,\n                                     const val_t* radE, val_t* radB) {\n    const size_t il = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x;\n    if (il >= nLoc) return;\n\n    const size_t i = rowBegin + il;\n    val_t sumB = ZERO;\n\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        if (i == j) continue;\n\n        const size_t k = j * nLoc + il;\n        const int tauij = tau[k];\n\n        // Skip if wave hasn't yet propagated from j to i\n        if (t < tauij) continue;\n\n        const val_t kij = kijT[k];\n        if (kij <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Get radiosity from source triangle at time when emission occurred\n        const size_t srcTime = static_cast<size_t>(t - tauij);\n        const val_t radJ = radB[srcTime * N + j];\n        if (radJ <= ZERO) continue;\n\n        // Accumulate contribution: form factor * area * source radiosity\n        val_t x = kij * areas[j];\n        x = (ONE < x) ? ONE : x;\n        sumB += x * radJ;\n    }\n\n    // Update radiosity: reflection + emission\n    radB[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i] = rho * sumB + radE[static_cast<size_t>(t) * N + i];\n}\n\n// Counts the entries of the local Kij block that exceed EPSILON\n__global__ void countNonZeroKernel(const val_t* kij, size_t n, unsigned long long* count) {\n    unsigned long long local = 0;\n    const size_t stride = static_cast<size_t>(gridDim.x) * blockDim.x;\n    for (size_t k = blockIdx.x * static_cast<size_t>(blockDim.x) + threadIdx.x; k < n; k += stride) {\n        if (kij[k] > EPSILON) ++local;\n    }\n    atomicAdd(count, local);\n}\n\n// Propagates radiosity over the timesteps. Each step's row is exchanged across ranks.\nvoid runSimulation(SimulationState& state) {\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    const size_t nLoc = state.localRows();\n    rootPrintf(\"Running wave propagation simulation...\\n\");\n\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n        if (nLoc > 0) {\n            const int blocks = static_cast<int>((nLoc + THREADS_PER_BLOCK - 1) / THREADS_PER_BLOCK);\n            simulationStepKernel<<<blocks, THREADS_PER_BLOCK>>>(\n                static_cast<int>(t), N, nLoc, state.rowBegin, state.reflectivity,\n                state.areasD.get(), state.tauD.get(), state.kijD.get(),\n                state.radED.get(), state.radBD.get());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radB.data() + t * N + state.rowBegin,\n                                  state.radBD.get() + t * N + state.rowBegin,\n                                  nLoc * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n        }\n\n        allgatherRowBlocks(state.radB.data() + t * N, N, MPI_FLOAT);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(state.radBD.get() + t * N, state.radB.data() + t * N,\n                              N * sizeof(val_t), cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n        if ((t + 1) % 10 == 0 || t + 1 == T) {\n            rootPrintf(\"  Timestep %zu/%zu\\n\", t + 1, T);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Distance Computation (Cross-Correlation)\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid computeDistances(SimulationState& state) {\n    rootPrintf(\"Computing distances via cross-correlation...\\n\");\n    const size_t N = state.numTriangles;\n    const size_t T = state.numTimesteps;\n    const size_t nLoc = state.localRows();\n\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 16)\n    for (size_t il = 0; il < nLoc; ++il) {\n        const size_t i = state.rowBegin + il;\n        val_t maxCorr = ZERO;\n        int bestT = 0;\n\n        // Discrete cross-correlation to find time delay\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < T; ++t) {\n            val_t sum = ZERO;\n\n            for (size_t tt = t; tt < T; ++tt) {\n                val_t pB = state.radB[tt * N + i];\n                val_t pS = state.radB[(tt - t) * N + state.sourceIndex];\n                sum += pS * pB;\n            }\n\n            if (sum > maxCorr) {\n                maxCorr = sum;\n                bestT = static_cast<int>(t);\n            }\n        }\n\n        state.distances[i] = WAVE_SPEED * static_cast<val_t>(bestT);\n    }\n\n    allgatherRowBlocks(state.distances.data(), N, MPI_FLOAT);\n}\n\n// Number of Kij entries above EPSILON across all ranks\nunsigned long long countNonZeroFormFactors(const SimulationState& state) {\n    const size_t n = state.localRows() * state.numTriangles;\n    DevBuf<unsigned long long> countD = allocDevice<unsigned long long>(1);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemset(countD.get(), 0, sizeof(unsigned long long)));\n    if (n > 0) {\n        countNonZeroKernel<<<256, 256>>>(state.kijD.get(), n, countD.get());\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n    }\n    unsigned long long local = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(&local, countD.get(), sizeof(local), cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, &local, 1, MPI_UNSIGNED_LONG_LONG, MPI_SUM, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    return local;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Validation\n// ============================================================================\n\nbool validateResults(const SimulationState& state, unsigned long long nonZeroKijGlobal) {\n    rootPrintf(\"\\nValidation:\\n\");\n\n    // Check that distances are non-negative\n    bool allNonNegative = true;\n    val_t minDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::max();\n    val_t maxDist = std::numeric_limits<val_t>::lowest();\n    val_t sumDist = ZERO;\n    int nonZeroCount = 0;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        val_t d = state.distances[i];\n        if (d < 0) {\n            allNonNegative = false;\n            rootPrintf(\"  ERROR: Negative distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n        }\n        if (!std::isfinite(d)) {\n            rootPrintf(\"  ERROR: Non-finite distance at triangle %zu: %f\\n\", i, d);\n            return false;\n        }\n        minDist = std::min(minDist, d);\n        maxDist = std::max(maxDist, d);\n        sumDist += d;\n        if (d > EPSILON) nonZeroCount++;\n    }\n\n    rootPrintf(\"  Distance range: [%.4f, %.4f]\\n\", minDist, maxDist);\n    rootPrintf(\"  Average distance: %.4f\\n\", sumDist / static_cast<val_t>(state.numTriangles));\n    rootPrintf(\"  Non-zero distances: %d/%zu\\n\", nonZeroCount, state.numTriangles);\n\n    // Check source distance is zero or very small\n    val_t srcDist = state.distances[state.sourceIndex];\n    if (srcDist > WAVE_SPEED * 2) {\n        rootPrintf(\"  WARNING: Source triangle distance is non-zero: %.4f\\n\", srcDist);\n    }\n\n    // Check radiosity propagation (some triangles should have received energy)\n    int receivedEnergy = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        for (size_t t = 0; t < state.numTimesteps; ++t) {\n            if (state.radB[t * state.numTriangles + i] > EPSILON) {\n                receivedEnergy++;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    rootPrintf(\"  Triangles receiving energy: %d/%zu\\n\", receivedEnergy, state.numTriangles);\n\n    if (receivedEnergy == 0) {\n        rootPrintf(\"  ERROR: No triangles received energy - simulation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    // Check Kij matrix (should have some non-zero entries)\n    const size_t kijCount = state.numTriangles * state.numTriangles;\n    int nonZeroKij = static_cast<int>(nonZeroKijGlobal);\n    rootPrintf(\"  Non-zero form factors: %d/%zu (%.2f%%)\\n\",\n               nonZeroKij, kijCount,\n               100.0f * nonZeroKij / static_cast<val_t>(kijCount));\n\n    if (nonZeroKij == 0) {\n        rootPrintf(\"  ERROR: All form factors are zero - visibility computation failed\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    if (!allNonNegative) {\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    rootPrintf(\"  Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n    return true;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Hash for Verification\n// ============================================================================\n\nuint64_t computeHash(const SimulationState& state) {\n    uint64_t hash = 0;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < state.numTriangles; ++i) {\n        const uint32_t* ptr = reinterpret_cast<const uint32_t*>(&state.distances[i]);\n        hash ^= (static_cast<uint64_t>(*ptr) + i) * 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL;\n    }\n    return hash;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Helper: Compute subdivision level from target triangle count\n// ============================================================================\n\nint getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(int targetTriangles) {\n    // Icosphere: 20 triangles initially, 4x per subdivision\n    // subdivisions: 0->20, 1->80, 2->320, 3->1280, 4->5120, 5->20480\n    int subdivisions = 0;\n    int triangles = 20;\n    while (triangles < targetTriangles && subdivisions < 6) {\n        subdivisions++;\n        triangles *= 4;\n    }\n    return subdivisions;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// Main\n// ============================================================================\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    rootPrintf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    rootPrintf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"  -n <num>     Target number of triangles (default: 320)\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"               Actual count will be rounded to nearest icosphere level:\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"               20, 80, 320, 1280, 5120, 20480\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"  -t <num>     Number of timesteps (default: 50)\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"  -s <num>     Source triangle index (default: 0)\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"  -r <val>     Reflectivity 0.0-1.0 (default: 0.8)\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"  -o           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &gRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &gSize);\n\n    int targetTriangles = 320;\n    int timesteps = 50;\n    int sourceIdx = 0;\n    val_t reflectivity = 0.8f;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            targetTriangles = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-t\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            timesteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            sourceIdx = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            reflectivity = static_cast<val_t>(atof(argv[++i]));\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-o\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            rootPrintf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    int subdivisions = getSubdivisionsForTriangleCount(targetTriangles);\n\n    rootPrintf(\"Room Response Simulation Benchmark\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"===================================\\n\");\n    rootPrintf(\"Target triangles: %d (using %d subdivisions)\\n\", targetTriangles, subdivisions);\n    rootPrintf(\"Timesteps: %d\\n\", timesteps);\n    rootPrintf(\"Source triangle: %d\\n\", sourceIdx);\n    rootPrintf(\"Reflectivity: %.2f\\n\", reflectivity);\n    rootPrintf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    rootPrintf(\"MPI ranks: %d\\n\", gSize);\n    rootPrintf(\"\\n\");\n\n    selectDevice();\n\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    {\n        // Initialize\n        SimulationState state;\n        initializeSimulation(state, subdivisions, static_cast<size_t>(timesteps),\n                             static_cast<size_t>(sourceIdx), reflectivity);\n\n        rootPrintf(\"\\n\");\n\n        // Precomputation\n        MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        auto startPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n        computeTimeDelays(state);\n        computeFormFactors(state);\n\n        MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        auto endPre = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n        auto preDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endPre - startPre).count();\n\n        rootPrintf(\"Precomputation time: %ld ms\\n\", preDuration);\n        rootPrintf(\"\\n\");\n\n        // Simulation\n        MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        auto startSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n        runSimulation(state);\n\n        MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        auto endSim = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n        auto simDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endSim - startSim).count();\n\n        rootPrintf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", simDuration);\n        rootPrintf(\"\\n\");\n\n        // Distance computation\n        MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        auto startDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n\n        computeDistances(state);\n\n        MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        auto endDist = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n        auto distDuration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(endDist - startDist).count();\n\n        rootPrintf(\"Distance computation time: %ld ms\\n\", distDuration);\n        rootPrintf(\"\\n\");\n\n        // Total time\n        long totalTime = preDuration + simDuration + distDuration;\n        rootPrintf(\"Total computation time: %ld ms\\n\", totalTime);\n\n        // Performance metrics\n        size_t n = state.numTriangles;\n        size_t t = state.numTimesteps;\n        double kijOps = static_cast<double>(n * n);\n        double simOps = static_cast<double>(n * n * t);\n        double distOps = static_cast<double>(n * t * t);\n\n        rootPrintf(\"\\nPerformance:\\n\");\n        rootPrintf(\"  Triangles: %zu\\n\", n);\n        rootPrintf(\"  Timesteps: %zu\\n\", t);\n        rootPrintf(\"  Form factor computations: %.2e\\n\", kijOps);\n        rootPrintf(\"  Simulation operations: %.2e\\n\", simOps);\n        rootPrintf(\"  Distance computations: %.2e\\n\", distOps);\n        rootPrintf(\"  Total time per triangle: %.4f ms\\n\", static_cast<double>(totalTime) / n);\n\n        // Memory usage\n        size_t memKij = n * n * sizeof(val_t);\n        size_t memTau = n * n * sizeof(int);\n        size_t memRad = 2 * t * n * sizeof(val_t);\n        size_t totalMem = memKij + memTau + memRad;\n        rootPrintf(\"  Memory usage: %.2f MB\\n\",
